title: Daily sales by product (till system)
summary: Daily units sold and revenue in euros per till product code for the Valdena gelato shop, sourced from the till system. Grain is one row per product per day (sale_date, product_code, units_sold, revenue_eur). Catalog coverage starts 2022-01-01 and is open-ended with daily refresh; approximately 310,000 rows. Two documented breaks affect the history window: a till replacement gap (2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10, no rows) and a product code change from 2024-04-01 with no mapping table.

documentation_excerpts: Units sold and revenue per product per day, from the till system. (catalog description)

The till system was replaced between 2024-02-05 and 2024-03-10. No sales were recorded in that period. Treat those days as missing, not as zero sales. sales.daily_by_product has no rows for those days. (wiki till_migration_2024, last edited 2024-03-12)

From 2024-04-01, product codes changed. Codes ending in "L" were replaced by new codes. No mapping table exists between the old and new codes. Old and new codes can only be matched by product name, and some names are not unique. sales.products lists only the current codes. (wiki product_codes_2024, last edited 2024-04-02)
quality_notes: Till replacement gap: wiki till_migration_2024 (edited 2024-03-12) says no rows for 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10; these are missing, not zero. Falls inside the history window (2023-06-01 to 2025-05-31).

Product code change from 2024-04-01 (wiki product_codes_2024, edited 2024-04-02): codes ending in 'L' replaced, no mapping table; matching only by product name, and names are not unique. Affects N2 directly and any product-level analysis across the break.

No opening/closed flag in this table; closed days may appear only as absent rows, so zero-sales days cannot be distinguished from closures without the shop calendar (internal.store.calendar, not profiled here).
Catalog does not say whether units_sold or revenue_eur is the primary sales measure.
Catalog says daily refresh and last refreshed 2026-10-14, but completeness for the recent window (to 2026-03-31) was not verified; no sample was possible.
Wiki backlinks list only till_migration_2024; product_codes_2024 was found by search, not via the catalog backlink list, so its link to this table relies on its own text.
Catalog row_count_approx 310,000 is stated without a column-width or period breakdown; not checked.
